subject: Re: Accepted: Rula and Steffan | Encord @ Thu 29 May 2025 2:30pm - 3pm (BST) (steffan@encord.com)
text:
Hi Steffan,

Thanks for getting back to me. I think I will need to move this to
tomorrow morning.

I’m currently exploring platforms that support scalable, high-quality data
annotation and model feedback pipelines, especially for complex and
multimodal datasets (image, video, text etc.). I'm looking to gain a
well-rounded understanding of how different platforms compare  before
shortlising providers - both technically and in terms of user experience -
and would love to learn more about how Encord differentiates in the
following areas:

   -

   Integrated workflows: from data curation through annotation, review, and
   model evaluation
   -

   Flexibility around annotation interfaces and ontology design
   -

   Support for active learning, model-assisted labeling, or custom model
   integration
   -

   Handling of complex edge cases and quality assurance at scale
   -

   Suitability for regulated industries or sensitive data and red teaming

It would also be helpful to see a walk-through of the user journey—how
customers onboard, set up projects, manage workflows, and engage annotators
or subject matter experts and difficult and edge cases. Understanding who
the typical users are (e.g., data ops teams, ML engineers, external
annotators) and how they interact with the platform would really round out
the picture.

Looking forward to learning more about Encord.

Best regards,
